title: My Quiet Bible · Wadek, kapakap, nehne, wiahpwuhrehng
description: Wadek, kapakap, nehne, wiahpwuhrehng. Paipel nan kawehwe {{versions}} oh lokaia {{languages}}, wasa en pedikih 🙏 pwe komw en kapakap ngihl laud duwen me komw wadek, oh pwihn tikitik me rir pwe komw en nehne noumw kapakap kan. Ni mehlel, sohte kahlik, e kin doadoahk ni sohte intanet.
sub: Paipel ihte: sohte koasoandi en wadek, sohte feed, sohte kahlik. Ni mehlel, oh e kin doadoahk ni sohte intanet.
hint: Sohte anahne kileldi mwar. E kin ritingala met nan noumw browser.
verseSub:
Kawehwe {{versions}} nan lokaia {{languages}}, koaros sohte ahneki soumas de ahneki laisens ritiritla.
          Iretik ehu ihte, nan ekei rehrail:
biblesP: Kawehwe {{versions}} nan lokaia {{languages}}: King James, Louis Segond 1910, Luther, Reina-Valera, Paipel en Ipru oh Kadehde Kapw en Krihk, Paipel en Etiopia nan lokaia English, French oh Geʻez, oh pil tohtohsang. Kasawihada lel ehu weneu ni ahnsou ehu.
searchP: Lepin lokaia ehu, kokoahte, lepin lokaia riau me kerepe pene, nan Paipel ehu de tohto, oh mehkan me diarada kin wadawadek ni pwuhk koaros. Ntingihedi wasa ehu nan Paipel oh komw pahn leledo wasao. Pil nempe en Strong's.
offlineH: E kin doadoahk ni sohte intanet
offlineP: Paipel kan me komw kin wadek kin mihmihte nan noumw delepwohn. Nan sompihr, pohn nahna kan, nan pere pah: e kin ritingala ni iretik me komw kanekehla ie, ni sohte intanet.
marksH: Kasansal kan, nting kan oh kilel kan
marksP: Kalahr waluh, nting ehu pohn iretik ehu de pohn pali ehu pwon, ripen ehu pwehn wasa kan me komw kin pwurpwurdo ie. Wahdo mehkan me komw kolokol nan app en Paipel teikan. Kilelehki iren pwe ehu duwehte pen marain, de kalaudehki ah lepin nting kan.
devicesP: Ma komw men ihte. Pedolong ki kih en pedolong de nempe me kadardohng komwi nan email, oh noumw kasansal kan, nting kan oh koasoandi kan pahn idawehnkomwi. Dipwisou keriau kin pedolong sang keieu ki link ehu; sohte mehkot me komw pahn ntingihedi.
verseShareP: Kadarala pali ehu ong WhatsApp, Facebook de X ki doaloapwoat ehu, duwehte kilel ehu me meleilei me wiawihda nan noumw dipwisou.
readingP: Font weneu, ehu pwehn me sohte kak kilang mwahu. Mesen nting laud duwehte me komw anahne, oh wasa en pedikih me komw sohte pahn kehla. Wiliandi irelaud ki pein limomw. Marain, Sepia de Rotorot, duwehte pali wet.
nots:
• Sohte koasoandi en wadek. Sohte padahk en rahn koaros. Sohte mehkot me se pilada ong komwi.
  • Sohte kahlik. Sohte idawehn. Sohte cookie.
  • Sohte pweinen pedolong. Sohte mehkot me loakdi.
  • Sohte anahne akaunt. Pedolong ihte ma komw men sync.
free: My Quiet Bible iei ni mehlel, oh e pahn duwehte kohkohlahte. Ma e kin sewese komwi, komw kak sewese pwe lamp en mwohmwohte. Sohte mehkot pahn pein koasoane met.
installSub: Mwuri e kin ritingala ni mesen delepwohn pwon duwehte app teikan, tamataman wasa me komw lel ie, oh doadoahk ni sohte intanet.
installSubComputer: Mwuri e kin ritingala nan pein ah window duwehte app teikan, tamataman wasa me komw lel ie, oh doadoahk ni sohte intanet.
iosSteps:
• Ritingala Paipel nan Safari.
  • Pedikih wasa en menu nan address bar, mwuri Share {svg}. Nan iPhone mering kan, Share mihmi nan bar powe.
  • Pedikih View More, mwuri Add to Home Screen {svg}.
  • Mweidohng Open as Web App en mihmihte oh pedikih Add. Lamp pahn sansalda nan noumw Home Screen.
iosNote: Wiahda met sang Paipel, kaidehn sang pali wet, pwe lamp en ritingala nanpwungen noumw wadek. Doadoahngki Safari: browser teikan nan iPhone oh iPad sohte kin kak ahnsou koaros kapatahiong app.
orSafari: De, ni sohte App Store, sang Safari:
androidNote: Pedikih pak ehu. Sohte mehkot pahn kotehla nan app store.
androidInstalled: Installihr. Ritingala lamp iangahki noumw app teikan.
androidSteps:
• Ritingala Paipel nan Chrome, de browser me komw kin doadoahngki.
  • Ritingala menu en browser, me kin iei kilel silimen {svg} pah palimaun.
  • Pedikih Install and create shortcut (ekei browser kin ndinda Add to Home screen).
  • Pilada Install, kaidehn Create shortcut. Mwuri pedikih Install pwuhrehng.
  • Lamp pahn sansalda iangahki noumw app teikan.
computerNote: E kin ritingala nan pein ah window, duwehte app teikan.
computerInstalled: Installihr. Ritingala My Quiet Bible iangahki noumw app teikan.
computerSteps:
• Ritingala Paipel nan Chrome de Edge.
  • Pedikih kilel en install ni imwin palimaun en address bar, mesen kompiuder ehu me ahneki kilel en ahl {svg}, mwuri Install.
  • De mweidohng tab en mihmihte. E kin doadoahk duwehte, oh tamataman wasa me komw lel ie.
footNote: Nting koaros sohte ahneki soumas de ahneki laisens ritiritla. Laisens en kawehwe koaros mihmi nan app.
prayP: ngihl laud, ki wasa en pedikih ehu, duwen me komw kahrehnda wadek.
shareP: noumw kapakap kan, ni ahnsou me komw men, rehn aramas malaulau me kerenkomwi.
repeatP: lakapw. E kin tamataman wasa me komw lel ie, oh rahn me komw soutoukoh.
prayH: Kapakap ki wasa en pedikih ehu
prayLong: Wasa en pedikih 🙏 kin mihmihte, limwahn bar en rapahki. Pedikih oh ndahng noumw kapakap ngihl laud. E kin kolokolda iangahki iretik kan me komw wadewadek, eri mwuri komw kak rongpwurehng oh kilang dahme komw kapakapki.
prayTicks:
• Sohte mehkot me komw pahn ntingihedi oh sohte mehkot me komw pahn koasoandi.
  • Noumw kapakap kan kin mihmihte nan noumw delepwohn, de sync loakdi ki kih ehu me komw ihte ahneki.
  • Mwurin Amen, kilang wehi kan me aramas akan kapakapki wihkwet. Wehio te me kin wadawadaki.
circlesVerse: “Pwe wasa me aramas riemen de silimen pokonpene ie ni ei mwar, I pahn mih nanpwungarail.”
circlesLong: Ni ahnsou me komw men, wiahda pwihn tikitik ehu pwehn noumw peneinei de kompoakepahmw malaulau. Nehne kapakap ehu, iretik ehu de nting ehu ki pedikih pak ehu. Irail kin rong, sapengki lokaia ehu, de sapengki 🙏, oh emenemen kin wadek iretik nan pein ah Paipel.
circlesAsk: Peki rehn noumw pwihn en kapakapki uhk, oh kilang kapehse me kapakapkier.
circlesTicks:
• Sohte anahne. Sohte mehkot kin pedoisang noumw delepwohn ma komw sohte pedikih Nehne.
  • Pwihn koaros ahneki pein ah kih. Ihte towe kan kak ritingala dahme mihmi loale; pil kiht sohte kak.
  • Pwihn kan anahne pedolong ni sohte pweine, ki kih en pedolong de nempe me kadardar ni email.
listenP: Doake iren pwe ehu, eri Rong. De doake Wadek iangahki nan ahn rapahki, oh lepin lokaia koaros kin marain ni ahn wadek. Sounwadek mehlel kan kin wadek BSB, King James oh Louis Segond. Ong nan sidohsa, nan kuhk, de mese me pwangadahr.
